brief: A balcony bed with a pipe run feeding water, two soil-filled bins and a drawer underneath for seed packets.

requirements.evidence: 2 half-s bases level0 with cut-face drawers + 2 half-s bases level1 on top; bins on level1
run:run-1 at level1; short single-cell irrigation run, could not extend straight across both cells (ROUTE_NO_PATH)
bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-half-s-third + bin:1,0,1~hex-bin-half-s-full both fillSoil + planted (basil-seedling, lettuce-butterhead-seedling)
drawer:0#0,0#cut + drawer:0#1,0#cut on level0 under level1 bins; no seed-packet prop exists in catalog so drawers left empty to show storage

finish.summary: Compact 2-cell stacked bed: two drawers underneath (level 0 half-s bases) and two soil-filled planted bins on top (level 1), with a short irrigation pipe run at level 1. check_build clear, no prop warnings.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

result.note: A drawer sits on the cut face of a half base: place a half base first. Half-n and half-s take any drawer style; half-e and half-w take a slide, swing or long drawer (find_sockets offers those once the half base is on). No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
